title: Nayeon v1
subtitle: Verified programme and capability readiness
scope: This dashboard reports auditable progress. No overall capability-readiness percentage has an approved denominator.

formal.closeDefinition: Build Plan phases 0–18 marked COMPLETE. This is a phase-closure fraction, not percentage of product finished.
formal.source: Original 16-sheet Nayeon v1 master audit workbook, saved 17 Oct 2026.

capabilities.name: OpenApp reference
capabilities.note: The OpenApp reference is a bounded proof, not a complete multi-tool UI.

capabilities.name: Trusted core
capabilities.note: Security contracts and tests exist; end-to-end agent release is not certified.

capabilities.name: Filesystem
capabilities.note: Limited file read/list/create/copy/delete. Recursive or full file manager behavior not claimed.

capabilities.name: Security / compliance
capabilities.note: Reviewed controls and engineering evidence; compliance/release assurance remains open.

capabilities.name: Computer control
capabilities.note: Exact target/keyboard/pointer controls tested. NOT unrestricted autonomous computer use.

capabilities.name: Secure BYOK
capabilities.note: Safe secret architecture and fake-only flows; live consumer key flow not verified.

capabilities.name: Memory
capabilities.note: Persistent user-controlled memory and retrieval not delivered.

capabilities.name: Assistant identity / config
capabilities.note: Presentation identity/config works in bounded scope; installable onboarding still open.

capabilities.name: Desktop UI
capabilities.stage: Offline prototype delivered; Phase 15 not started
capabilities.note: Offline Tk workspace/session from 8.30–8.31, not an installable normal-user client.

releaseGates.name: Installed desktop app starts without Python/Git/VS Code
Guided assistant identity and permissions onboarding works
BYOK key securely entered, stored, replaced and deleted
Provider key explicitly validated with safe status display
Normal GUI chat starts, continues, cancels conversations
Sensitive local action reviewed and approved in GUI
GUI request → action → observed verification end-to-end
User-controlled persistent memory and bounded proactive events
Signed clean-device installer and tested update/rollback

milestones.name: First-run integration acceptance
milestones.note: Scoped synthetic first-run, security and fault-recovery work completed; no real provider calls.

milestones.name: Offline Windows Workspace
milestones.note: Tk Conversation, Settings, Connection and local profile handling.

milestones.name: Trusted Offline Conversation Session
milestones.note: In-memory user/status pairs, one-use confirmed reset, stale-callback safeguards, audited Tk teardown.

evidence.sourceDocument: Private Nayeon v1 master audit workbook (not exposed on this public site)

notes: Computer Control: the verified Phase 6 bounded milestone is COMPLETE. Neither 10% nor 15% is an audited current maturity score.
Memory: Phase 9 is NOT STARTED. Historical 10%/15% figures are unsupported as current delivered readiness.
Security & Control is explicitly tracked: Phase 6 complete; phases 4, 8 and 16 in progress.
16 historical capability percentages and the 40% headline were retired because their weighting and denominator were not audited.
0/12 release gates are verified. No live AI conversation, voice, memory, browser, installer or unattended autonomy is claimed.
